name: Publish Queue
description: A seven-phase workflow for safely importing, approving, publishing, reconciling, and auditing social content.

phases.name: Import
phases.prompt: Identify the publish item, destination, source files, account context, and success criteria. Keep the item in draft state until approval.

phases.name: Preflight
phases.prompt: Check metadata, permissions, assets, destination requirements, and duplicate risk. Post evidence and a clear ready or blocked result.

phases.name: Creative QC
phases.prompt: Review the media, caption, claims, visual framing, and platform fit. Post only actionable fixes or explicit approval evidence.

phases.name: Human Approval
phases.prompt: Jonathan: approve, reject, or request specific revisions. This is a human gate; no agent may execute the publication without your response.

phases.name: Execute
phases.prompt: Execute only the approved publication action. Post the platform response, canonical identifier, and any failure without retrying outside scope.

phases.name: Reconcile
phases.prompt: Verify the published or queued state against the destination. Reconcile identifiers, timestamps, and delivery status with evidence.

phases.name: Audit
phases.prompt: Audit all gates and evidence. Post the final publish record, remaining risk, or a concrete blocker; do not claim completion without proof.
